blocks.text: Draft for Jared's approval. Built only from the monthly MLS® figures (SnapStats) for condos and townhomes in Central Park. No local notes, sold prices, building list or live listing feed yet; see the open items.

blocks.text: Central Park Burnaby Condos and Townhomes: streets and boundaries

items.t: The strata stock sits east of Central Park, because the park itself fills the west side between Boundary Road and Patterson Avenue. Heritage Burnaby bounds the park by 49th Avenue south, Kingsway north, Boundary Road west and Patterson Avenue east.

Wilson Avenue, Barker Avenue and Sardis Street carry the towers between Patterson Avenue and Metrotown Station, on the grid the City closes for Central Spark events on Patterson Avenue from Kingsway to Central Boulevard.

blocks.text: Central Park Burnaby Condos and Townhomes: the housing stock

items.t: Wilson Avenue holds the newest and tallest stock: Central Park House at 5987 Wilson Avenue, a 41-storey Bosa Properties tower completed in 2025 with townhomes at its base, beside Paramount at 5833 Wilson Avenue, Paramount II at 5899 Wilson Avenue and Place Meridian at 5967 Wilson Avenue.

Two buildings share one name: Central Park Place at 5652 Patterson Avenue and Central Park Place at 4160 Sardis Street, plus Grand Central Park Place at 6128 Patterson Avenue, Wimbledon Club at 6188 Patterson Avenue and Aldynne on the Park at 5883 Barker Avenue — confirm the civic address, never the name alone.

blocks.text: Central Park Burnaby Condos and Townhomes: rules that affect buyers

items.t: Every strata here with five or more lots must now hold a current depreciation report: since July 1, 2024 the Province requires reports on a five-year cycle, with no deferral vote, and Metro Vancouver stratas without one had until July 1, 2026 to comply.

Old rental-restriction bylaws in the Sardis Street and Patterson Avenue buildings are not enforceable: provincial changes removed strata long-term rental restrictions, while short-term rental rules can still apply.
New rezonings on the Kingsway and Wilson Avenue edges now proceed under the Burnaby Zoning Bylaw 2026, the bylaw the City's current amendment list amends.

blocks.text: Central Park Burnaby Condos and Townhomes: local details a buyer would not know

items.t: Swangard Stadium sits inside Central Park, so Wilson Avenue towers face event nights, not just park trails, on the Kingsway side.
The City's Central Spark event closes Patterson Avenue from Kingsway to Central Boulevard and blocks underground parking access for 5790, 5852 and 5932 Patterson Avenue during the event.
Chaffey-Burke Elementary at 4404 Sardis Street shares its street with the Central Park Place building at 4160 Sardis Street.
Maywood Community School at 4567 Imperial Street anchors the south edge by Imperial Street, the park's south boundary street.
Central Park Outdoor Pool is a named facility inside the park on the Imperial Street side, listed in the City's facility material with Swangard Stadium.

blocks.text: Central Park Burnaby Condos and Townhomes: costs and taxes

items.t: Burnaby's 2026 property taxes were due July 3, 2026, and late strata owners face the same penalty ladder as house owners: 5% after the July due date and a further 5% after the September due date, applied also to an unclaimed home owner grant.

New strata units can start life under one parent tax folio: Burnaby's apportionment process splits a developer's parent property into child strata units, and requests received after April 15 are processed after the July tax due date.

blocks.text: Central Park Burnaby Condos and Townhomes: getting around

items.t: Patterson Station is the area's Expo Line stop, and its bus services load on Central Boulevard and Beresford Street below the Wilson Avenue towers.
Bus 19 on Kingsway is the step-free fallback TransLink names for Patterson riders during the elevator closure, running to the Metrotown Station bus loop.

blocks.text: Central Park Burnaby Condos and Townhomes: risks and due diligence

items.t: Start with the depreciation report date: a Sardis Street or Patterson Avenue strata with no report, or one from before December 31, 2020, was required to obtain a new one by July 1, 2026 under the provincial rules.
Check which Central Park Place you are: the 5652 Patterson Avenue and 4160 Sardis Street stratas share a name, so a documents package pulled for the wrong one is a real error risk here.

blocks.text: Central Park home prices: what sold, November 2025 to October 2026

31 condos sold in Central Park with a median price of $527,000 (the middle half sold between $429,500 and $637,444), taking a median of 25 days to sell at 96.5% of the last list price; 6% sold above list. They had a median $630 per square foot, a median year built of 1990 and a median strata fee of $471 a month. 9 townhomes sold in Central Park with a median price of $870,000 (the middle half sold between $788,000 and $938,000), taking a median of 44 days to sell at 96.6% of the last list price; 22% sold above list. They had a median $763 per square foot, a median year built of 2009 and a median strata fee of $455 a month.

faq.q: How many condos and townhomes are for sale in Central Park?
faq.a: At the end of October 2026 the Greater Vancouver REALTORS® figures showed 25 condos and townhomes listed in Central Park. That is a month-end count and it moves daily; ask Jared what is on the market today.

faq.q: Is Central Park a buyers’ or sellers’ market for condos and townhomes?
faq.a: In October 2026, condos and townhomes in Central Park had a sales ratio of 8%, which the reports’ scale reads as a buyers’ market. On the reports’ scale under 12% favours buyers, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% favours sellers.

faq.q: How many condos and townhomes sold in Central Park from June to October 2026?
faq.a: Between June and October 2026, 22 condos and townhomes sold in Central Park; Burnaby as a whole recorded 916.

faq.q: Do these numbers separate condos from townhomes?
faq.a: No. The monthly reports publish condos and townhomes as one line, so every count here includes both. Jared can pull the split for a specific building or street.

faq.q: What did condos in Central Park sell for?
faq.a: From November 2025 to late October 2026, Central Park recorded 31 condo sales at a median of $527,000.

faq.q: How long do condos take to sell in Central Park?
faq.a: Typical time on the market was 25 days. At the median, sale prices were 96.5% of list, and 6% of sales closed above list (November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026).
